hypothesis: Global raw variance-normalized score can increase with fitted signal energy even for symmetric nulls because of grid mismatch; pooling bright and weak nulls may suppress weak signals. Diagnose on new calibration data; not established by previous run alone.

method.matched_comparison: All algorithms see identical prefix averages, identical independently generated background variance. No phase estimates from hidden labels; aligned observations assumed. Never treat four prefixes of the same event as independent.
method.score: A_F, A_R, A_S = best nonnegative centered unit-template projection; E=max(A_F,A_R,A_S)/sigma_background_mean; D=(A_F^2-A_R^2)/(sigma_background_mean^2*max(E,1)); E is observed matched-energy SNR proxy, not true injected SNR. R15 bank unchanged, exact time mirror.
method.threshold: Per repeat count and observed E bin, 97.5th empirical percentile of abs(D), higher quantile, calibration nulls only. Minimum 80 samples; unsupported bin abstains. No global threshold fallback. No threshold optimization using positives or evaluation. Store lock before eval.

calibration.noise: independent AR(1), rho=.35, sigma=.14 per view; matched 256-point background per view

evaluation.primary: At 8 repeats every seed: weak correct coverage >= R14+10 percentage points; weak wrong <=5%; null declaration <=5%; strong correct >=85% and no more than 5 percentage points below R14; zero paired strong hits lost vs R15 as separate protection gate. Report unsupported cells and per null family, all prefixes descriptive except primary. No use of old revealed eval rows.

stress.scenario: Common AR(1) noise shared across repeats (correlation 0.4), plus per-view small random alignment jitter; same common-noise model for separate background. Stress is descriptive OOD, no threshold tuning. Require null declaration <=5% and weak wrong <=5% for stress gate; no generalization claim if failed.

reconstruction.rule: Reuse exact frozen R15 implementation, no changes to reconstruction bank or selector, same y/truth for R15 and R15A. Evaluate on 8-repeat new double/clipped cases; report paired RMSE and linear baseline, do not claim old successes automatically transfer. Replay deterministic subset; no selection uses hidden truth.
reconstruction.gate: Double median <= linear and <= R14 on each pooled new family; clipped separately report and retain prior HOLD. Do not mix direction decisions with reconstruction selection.

scientific_ceiling: Synthetic morphology discrimination only, not a detector of retrocausality. No calibrated carrier response, real independent radio or paired UAP measurement. No production change or automatic veto.
spiral: Canonical 5D axis state chain with actual calibration, sensitivity, accumulation, reconstruction and OOD deltas. Preserve previous causal alternatives.
